semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Trustec Semiconductor is involved in the distribution of semiconductor equipment, parts, and consumables, which are essential for various stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Trustec Semiconductor Co., Ltd. operates as a distributor in the semiconductor industry, focusing on agency sales of equipment, parts, and consumables. The company supports the LED and IC packaging and testing segments with products such as LED epitaxy materials, photoluminescence analyzers, and essential tools for IC packaging like beryllium copper needles and sorting machines.

regional_presence.China: Trustec leverages its extensive industry network across China to deliver solutions.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Trustec has a strategic presence in Taiwan to support its distribution activities.
regional_presence.South Korea: Trustec operates in South Korea, focusing on delivering high-performance solutions.
